bio: You can specify the level of spiciness of your food at this three-storey restaurant in Little India, though many come for the Chilli Challenge on full moon nights simply to push their limit. But spiciness isn’t all that this chef has to offer – in fact, he balances it with sweet, sour, salty, bitter and astringent flavours. Choose between table seating downstairs and floor seating upstairs. Parties of two have a number of set menus to choose from....
